fit_reason: Whole boat (1970 Larson runabout with outboard) listed by a private owner; trailer not included but the boat itself is what's being sold.
findings: Dull, slightly chalky gelcoat along the port and starboard hull sides below the blue stripe
Grime and staining on the transom around the motor mount area
Yellowed, dingy Chrysler outboard cowling and lower unit
Dirt and debris visible inside the cockpit floor area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1970 Larson runabout. The hull sides look a bit dull and chalky, and the transom and outboard cowling have some grime and yellowing that a polish would brighten up. We do mobile gelcoat polish and pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
